parsed.rationale: One of the two `MetricRow` type-alias-object records lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift` in the `Wallpaper` package, which is clearly under an Examples/SampleApp path. The other lives in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugHUD.swift` in the `DebugPanel` package. The sample-app copy is a local convenience definition that mirrors (or approximates) the real one for demonstration purposes; collapsing it into the `DebugPanel` package would couple the sample app to that package unnecessarily. No structural evidence (Jaccard, shared fields, differing slots) was provided to suggest the two definitions are actually identical or that unification would be safe.
